text:
Kayla: Hi finance — vendor just sent the final invoice for the Q3 conference booth. Invoice INV-5567 is $12,560 but our PO PO-9087 was for $10,000. I paid nothing yet; vendor emailed the invoice and asked for payment. We need to split cost 70/30 between Marketing (MK-2026) and Sales (SL-2026). cc @Rahul for approval.

Expense-bot: FYI Redwood policy: invoices with >10% variance from PO require PO amendment or manager-approved variance memo + procurement sign-off. Please attach vendor invoice, signed SOW or contract, and the shipping/installation note. Use https://redwood.procurement/po-amend to request amendment.

Kayla: Attaching vendor invoice INV-5567 (pdf), signed SOW (sow-conference-2026.pdf), and a delivery note from booth vendor (deliver-0324.pdf). TEMP LINKS: https://files.redwood/inv-5567, https://files.redwood/sow, https://files.redwood/del. Will open PO amendment request now.

Nina: Finance — opening thread. Two quick asks: 1) confirm why invoice exceeds PO (line items or additional fees?), 2) confirm exact split amounts and cost centers to code payment. We'll hold payment until variance approved.

Kayla: Vendor added last-minute electrical power and a rental extension for two days. Line items: power install $1,200, rental extension $1,360. That totals the $2,560 over PO. Proposed split: Marketing pays booth + power = $8,680 (70%), Sales pays rental extension and lead gen kiosk = $3,880 (30%).

Rahul: I approve charging Marketing (MK-2026) for marketing-related items. Rahul approved 2026-04-12. However we need procurement sign-off for the extension line since it wasn't in the original SOW.

Jeff (Procurement): Procurement here — we need vendor confirmation email that authorized the extension (timestamped), or a change order signed by vendor rep. If vendor can email approval, we can push a PO amendment. Also confirm vendor bank details to match existing PO.

Kayla: Vendor email confirming extension attached: https://files.redwood/vendor-confirm-ext. Vendor bank details match PO-9087. I filed PO amendment request at https://redwood.procurement/po-amend/9087 and included the docs.

Expense-bot: PO amendment request received. Status: pending procurement review. Reminder: for multi-cost-center splits, include split percentage and GL codes in the amendment form to avoid rework.

Jeff (Procurement): Reviewed docs. Change order looks valid. I'll approve PO amendment and increase PO to $12,560 if Finance signs off on coding. Please confirm split GLs: MK-2026 -> GL 6100, SL-2026 -> GL 6205.

Nina: Confirming GL codes and split. Finance approves payment once PO amended and Rahul's approval present (we have it). Please create expense ticket EXP-7001 and reference INV-5567 + PO-9087 amendment. Kayla, route vendor invoice to finance@redwood with subject "Pay INV-5567 / PO-9087 AMEND" after Jeff approves.

Kayla: Done — vendor emailed final invoice to finance@redwood and I attached amendment approval. Submitted EXP-7001 in the system with split coding.

Expense-bot: EXP-7001 received. Status: awaiting procurement & finance sign-off. Expected payment in next AP cycle after approvals. If vendor needs earlier payment, escalate with AP lead.

Rahul: Thanks team. Kayla — please include a short note in Concur explaining the extension reason so we have audit trail.

Kayla: Added note "Vendor extended rental for additional demo days at sponsor request; approved by Rahul 2026-04-12" to EXP-7001. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Nina: All approvals in place. Jeff, mark PO amended when you can and we'll schedule payment for next run.

Jeff (Procurement): PO amended to $12,560 and change order attached to PO file. Marking done 2026-04-13.

Expense-bot: Payment scheduled for INV-5567 on next AP run. Closing thread unless issues arise.
